description: This PHP class 'EmployeeModel' is part of the HRM system and models employee data for serialization and normalization purposes. It creates a model representation of an Employee entity, setting entity data, filters, and attribute names for external use.

classes.name: EmployeeModel
classes.description: A model class that wraps an Employee entity for API serialization, implementing the Normalizable interface and using the ModelTrait trait.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EmployeeModel with an Employee entity, defining filters and attribute names for serialization.
